name: Alejandro Zumbado Vargas
title: Backend Developer
summary: Computer Engineer (TEC, 2019) with experience in Django and Node.js building REST APIs, integrations, and server-side logic for web and VR products. Currently at Opal Interactive, contributing to Startus's NestJS backend and the server logic for an AI avatar. In parallel, I design and operate my own backend systems in production: an AI content pipeline that runs with zero human intervention, and multiplayer networking layers for games (Unity Netcode + Relay).

experience.sub: Studio that takes on projects from various companies and distributes them across its dev team

Built Django backends powering React.js/Next.js frontends.
Database-driven content for editors and maps used in web/VR experiences.

Collaborated with cross-functional teams to improve system performance.

Optimized performance across devices and browsers.
